thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT triggered - HIGH - inference-gateway-prod - Elevated 5xx rate (us-east1) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert details: 5xx_rate=6.8% (threshold 1.0%) over 3m, 5xx_count=420/min, abnormal retry spike. PD key: PD-98321. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-98321
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: page sent to SRE oncall rotation (sara). Escalation policy: 3m -> oncall -> secondary.
sara: ack - taking it. I'm on-call for SRE. jumping in now.
mike: ping - any recent deploys around 03:05?
anna: yup, there was a small canary that touched the gateway routing logic at 03:02 (traffic-shaper v2). telemetry looked fine locally but might be cold-starts + increased qps.
sara: ok checking metrics, dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/inference-gateway/us-east1
sara: running quick check on pod health and kube events

```bash
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
# pods show READY 2/3 for several nodes
kubectl -n prod describe pod inference-gateway-7f5d
```

mike: seeing repeated 504s in the gateway logs, looks like upstream model pool rejecting inferences under load. snippet:

```text
2026-03-14T03:12:15Z gateway ERROR upstream request failed: connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T03:12:16Z gateway WARN latency=1200ms status=502 route=/v1/generate
```

david_prod: customer impact: error rate above alerting threshold for 12 customers, top impacted: acme-inc (10% of their requests), buildly (7%). notify support if we need comms.
lucy_support: on it, pinging top 3 customers now.
sara: preliminary triage - likely capacity/backpressure in us-east1 model pool + a routing change from canary. mitigation plan: 1) scale gateway/model pool; 2) rollback traffic-shaper canary if needed; 3) enable fallback model variant for latency-sensitive routes.
mike: +1 for scale up and fallback. how fast can we scale GPU pool?
sara: we can add 2 nodes via autoscaler CLI, should be ~4-6m to be ready. executing scale now.

```bash
# scale up pool
rctl pool scale --pool inference-gpu-prod-us-east1 --add-nodes 2 --reason "PD-98321 5xx spike"
# apply temporary routing to fallback small model
rctl routing set --route "/v1/generate" --fallback-model redwood/gpt-small:v1 --duration 30m
```

anna: I'm going to roll back the traffic-shaper canary to previous version (v1) to eliminate the routing change variable. preparing rollback.
sara: ack, do it and post the command you run.

anna: rollback done - traffic-shaper reverted to v1 at 03:18 UTC. monitoring.
sara: scale command succeeded, pool adding 2 nodes (instances provisioning). ETA ~5m.
mike: after rollback + scale, 5xx dropped to ~2.0% in 2m. still above baseline but trending down.
david_prod: customer error counts decreasing; only 3 customers still above 0.5%.
lucy_support: updated ACME and Buildly: told them we're mitigating and will follow up after stability.
sara: switching to monitoring mode. keeping fallback model on for 30m. If stable for 30m we'll remove fallback.
mike: check for retry storms from clients - if many clients retry aggressively that could cause aftershock. can we enable short-term token-bucket rate limiting per IP?
sara: enabling soft rate limit on gateway for 10m (burst 50, rate 20r/s) to damp retries.

```bash
rctl gateway update --name inference-gateway --rate-limit "burst=50,rate=20r/s" --duration 10m
```

mike: good. also adding an alert to suppress noisy PD escalations while we're stabilizing (so we don't get autopage loops).
sara: adding PD suppression window 15m for this alert key PD-98321.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: suppression rule applied for incident PD-98321 (15m). Notifications limited to oncall and follow-ups.
sara: 03:28 UTC - 5xx at 0.9% now. marking as monitoring.
mike: I'll take overnight watch. sara, handing off the incident to me for 03:30-11:30 shift. please add timeline to incident doc and any followups.
sara: handing off to @mike. notes: cause = combination of canary routing change + transient model pool capacity pressure; mitigations taken = rollback canary, scale pool + fallback model, soft rate limits, PD suppression.
mike: ack handoff. will watch dashboards and escalate if it regresses.
lucy_support: I'll keep customers updated and will post any support tickets.
david_prod: adding note to release engineering: hold further routing deploys for 24h, need a postmortem + canary tuning.
sara: creating incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/PD-98321 - will paste timeline and remediation steps.

```text
Timeline (short):
03:02 UTC - traffic-shaper canary deployed v2
03:11 UTC - PagerDuty alert PD-98321 fired - 5xx spike
03:13 UTC - oncall ack (sara)
03:15 UTC - rollback traffic-shaper to v1
03:17 UTC - scale GPU pool + enable fallback model
03:28 UTC - 5xx < 1%, incident moved to monitoring
03:30 UTC - handoff to mike
```

mike: leaving a note to run load-repro locally against canary tomorrow. sara, please include any logs you saved.
sara: will attach debug logs and kube events in the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident PD-98321 status: MONITORING. Auto-close rule: stable <1% 5xx for 30m -> close. Next automated check at 03:58 UTC.
lucy_support: thanks team. I'll send an interim email to top customers in 15m.
mike: thanks, all. I'll ping if anything changes.
sara: thanks everyone for the quick responses. postmortem required, i'll start draft tomorrow. :white_check_mark:"
